slides.say: Daniel the photographer worked in the hall on one day last week. He photographed exactly one percent of the wedding guests. Which of these cannot be the day he worked?

slides: So they ask which day is impossible. Let's look for what could break.

slides.say: Daniel photographed people. People come whole, so one percent of the guests must be a whole number.
at: one percent of the guests must be

slides.say: One percent is the number divided by a hundred. Sunday has three hundred guests, so one percent is three people. Monday, four hundred, four people. Tuesday, five hundred, five people.
Thursday's bar stops halfway between three hundred and four hundred. So three hundred fifty guests.
Three hundred fifty divided by a hundred is three and a half. Half a person? That's impossible.
So Thursday cannot be the day.
Choice number four is our answer, and I'll see you in the next question.
at: Choice number four is our answer
